#195 정답 toxicology · simple What is the most common bond type?

질문 What is the most common bond type?

evidence most common bond type refers MAX(COUNT(bond_type))

정답 SQL

SELECT
  T.bond_typeFROM (
  SELECT
    bond_type,
    COUNT(bond_id)
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY
    bond_type
  ORDER BY
    COUNT(bond_id) DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS T
원래 SQL
SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

  bond_typeORDER BY
  COUNT(bond_type) DESCLIMIT 1

#197 오답 toxicology · moderate single_value_differs Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.

질문 Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.

evidence single-bonded molecules refers to bond_type = '-' ; average number of oxygen atom = AVG(element = 'o')

정답 SQL

SELECT
  AVG(oxygen_count)FROM (
  SELECT
    T1.molecule_id,
    COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count
  FROM atom AS T1
  INNER JOIN bond AS T2
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
  WHERE
    T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o'
  GROUP BY
    T1.molecule_id
) AS oxygen_counts
원래 SQL
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id  WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o'  GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) AS oxygen_counts

예측 SQL

SELECT
  AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atomsFROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN bond AS b
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '-'
  JOIN connected AS c
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom AS a
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  WHERE
    a.element = 'o'
  GROUP BY
    m.molecule_id
)
원래 SQL
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms FROM ( SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '-' JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'o' GROUP BY m.molecule_id );

#198 오답 toxicology · challenging single_value_differs On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?

질문 On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?

evidence carcinogenic molecules refers to label = '+'; single-bonded refers to bond_type = '-'; average = DIVIDE(SUM(bond_type = '-'), COUNT(atom_id))

정답 SQL

SELECT
  AVG(single_bond_count)FROM (
  SELECT
    T3.molecule_id,
    COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count
  FROM bond AS T1
  INNER JOIN atom AS T2
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
  INNER JOIN molecule AS T3
    ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
  WHERE
    T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+'
  GROUP BY
    T3.molecule_id
) AS subquery
원래 SQL
SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS T1  INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id) AS subquery

예측 SQL

SELECT
  AVG(single_bond_count) AS average_single_bonded_carcinogenicFROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(c.atom_id) AS single_bond_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN atom AS a
    ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  JOIN connected AS c
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  JOIN bond AS b
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE
    m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY
    m.molecule_id
)
원래 SQL
SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS average_single_bonded_carcinogenic FROM ( SELECT COUNT(c.atom_id) AS single_bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-' GROUP BY m.molecule_id );

  (
    SUM(element = 'c') * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id)

JOIN bond
  ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_idWHERE
  bond.bond_type = '='
원래 SQL

#208 정답 toxicology · moderate Which type of label is the most numerous in atoms with hydrogen?

질문 Which type of label is the most numerous in atoms with hydrogen?

evidence with hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; label most numerous in atoms refers to MAX(COUNT(label));

정답 SQL

SELECT
  T.labelFROM (
  SELECT
    T2.label,
    COUNT(T2.molecule_id)
  FROM atom AS T1
  INNER JOIN molecule AS T2
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
  WHERE
    T1.element = 'h'
  GROUP BY
    T2.label
  ORDER BY
    COUNT(T2.molecule_id) DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS t
원래 SQL
SELECT T.label FROM ( SELECT T2.label, COUNT(T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'h' GROUP BY T2.label ORDER BY COUNT(T2.molecule_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) t

예측 SQL

SELECT
  labelFROM moleculeWHERE
  molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE
      element = 'h'
  )GROUP BY
  labelORDER BY
  COUNT(*) DESCLIMIT 1
원래 SQL
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'h' ) GROUP BY label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

#215 오답 toxicology · challenging column_mismatch row_set_differs How many atoms with iodine and with sulfur type elements are there in single bond molecules?

질문 How many atoms with iodine and with sulfur type elements are there in single bond molecules?

evidence with iodine element refer to element = 'i'; with sulfur element refers to element = 's'; single type bond refers to bond_type = '-'; Should consider the distinct atoms when counting;

정답 SQL

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'i' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS iodine_nums,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 's' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS sulfur_numsFROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2
  ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond AS T3
  ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_idWHERE
  T3.bond_type = '-'
원래 SQL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'i' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS iodine_nums , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 's' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS sulfur_nums FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '-'

예측 SQL

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_countFROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond AS b
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_idWHERE
  b.bond_type = '-' AND (
    a.element = 'i' OR a.element = 's'
  )
원래 SQL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND (a.element = 'i' OR a.element = 's');

#218 오답 toxicology · challenging single_value_differs What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?

질문 What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?

evidence label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; contain fluorine refers to element = 'f'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'f') * 100, COUNT(molecule_id)) where label = '+'; Should consider the distinct atoms when counting;

정답 SQL

SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element <> 'f' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id)FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_idWHERE
  T2.label = '+'
원래 SQL
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element <> 'f' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

예측 SQL

SELECT
  (
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_no_fluorineFROM molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN atom AS a
  ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_idWHERE
  m.label = '+'
원래 SQL
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_no_fluorine FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';

#231 오답 toxicology · challenging column_mismatch gold_rows_with_extra_columns Which bond type accounted for the majority of the bonds found in molecule TR010 and state whether or not this molecule is carcinogenic?

질문 Which bond type accounted for the majority of the bonds found in molecule TR010 and state whether or not this molecule is carcinogenic?

evidence TR010 is the molecule id; majority of the bond found refers to MAX(COUNT(bond_type));

정답 SQL

SELECT
  T.bond_typeFROM (
  SELECT
    T1.bond_type,
    COUNT(T1.molecule_id)
  FROM bond AS T1
  WHERE
    T1.molecule_id = 'TR010'
  GROUP BY
    T1.bond_type
  ORDER BY
    COUNT(T1.molecule_id) DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS T
원래 SQL
SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT T1.bond_type, COUNT(T1.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1  WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY T1.bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(T1.molecule_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

예측 SQL

SELECT
  bond_type,
  COUNT(bond_type) AS bond_count,
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM molecule
      WHERE
        molecule_id = 'TR010' AND label LIKE '%carcinogenic%'
    )
    THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS is_carcinogenicFROM bondWHERE
  molecule_id = 'TR010'GROUP BY
  bond_typeORDER BY
  bond_count DESCLIMIT 1
원래 SQL

#244 오답 toxicology · moderate single_value_differs tied_alternative_exists Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic?

질문 Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic?

evidence double bond refers to bond_type = ' = '; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic

정답 SQL

SELECT
  T1.labelFROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    T.molecule_id,
    COUNT(T.bond_type)
  FROM bond AS T
  WHERE
    T.bond_type = '='
  GROUP BY
    T.molecule_id
  ORDER BY
    COUNT(T.bond_type) DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
원래 SQL
SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT T.molecule_id, COUNT(T.bond_type) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T.bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

예측 SQL

SELECT
  COUNT(*) > 0 AS is_carcinogenicFROM (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN bond AS b
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE
    b.bond_type = ' = '
  GROUP BY
    m.molecule_id
  ORDER BY
    COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS max_double_bond_molecule
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON max_double_bond_molecule.molecule_id = m.molecule_idWHERE
  m.label = '+'
원래 SQL
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS is_carcinogenic FROM ( SELECT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS max_double_bond_molecule JOIN molecule m ON max_double_bond_molecule.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';

#250 오답 toxicology · moderate empty_result column_mismatch tied_alternative_exists Of all the carcinogenic molecules, which one has the most double bonds?

질문 Of all the carcinogenic molecules, which one has the most double bonds?

evidence label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; double bond refers to bond_type = ' = ';

정답 SQL

SELECT
  T.molecule_idFROM (
  SELECT
    T3.molecule_id,
    COUNT(T1.bond_type)
  FROM bond AS T1
  INNER JOIN molecule AS T3
    ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
  WHERE
    T3.label = '+' AND T1.bond_type = '='
  GROUP BY
    T3.molecule_id
  ORDER BY
    COUNT(T1.bond_type) DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS T
원래 SQL
SELECT T.molecule_id FROM ( SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.label = '+' AND T1.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T1.bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

예측 SQL

SELECT
  m.molecule_id,
  COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_countFROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = 'WHERE
  m.label = '+'GROUP BY
  m.molecule_idORDER BY
  double_bond_count DESCLIMIT 1
원래 SQL
SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = ' WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC LIMIT 1;

#254 오답 toxicology · moderate single_value_differs What percentage of bonds have the most common combination of atoms' elements?

질문 What percentage of bonds have the most common combination of atoms' elements?

evidence DIVIDE(COUNT(bond_id), COUNT(atom_id where MAX(COUNT(atom_id)) ))

정답 SQL

SELECT
  CAST((
    SELECT
      COUNT(T1.atom_id)
    FROM connected AS T1
    INNER JOIN bond AS T2
      ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
    GROUP BY
      T2.bond_type
    ORDER BY
      COUNT(T2.bond_id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS REAL) * 100 / (
    SELECT
      COUNT(atom_id)
    FROM connected
  )
원래 SQL
SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id GROUP BY T2.bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(T2.bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS REAL) * 100 / ( SELECT COUNT(atom_id) FROM connected )

예측 SQL

SELECT
  (
    COUNT(bond.bond_id) * 100.0 / (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM bond
    )
  ) AS percentageFROM bond
JOIN connected
  ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1
  ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2
  ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_idWHERE
  (a1.element, a2.element) IN (
    SELECT
      a1.element,
      a2.element
    FROM connected
    JOIN atom AS a1
      ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2
      ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY
      a1.element,
      a2.element
    ORDER BY
      COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
원래 SQL
SELECT (COUNT(bond.bond_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)) AS percentage FROM bond JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE (a1.element, a2.element) IN ( SELECT a1.element, a2.element FROM connected JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 );

#263 오답 toxicology · challenging row_count_differs row_set_differs What is the composition of element chlorine in percentage among the single bond molecules?

질문 What is the composition of element chlorine in percentage among the single bond molecules?

evidence element chlorine refers to element = 'cl'; single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'cl'), COUNT(atom_id)) as percent where bond_type = '-'

정답 SQL

SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.element = 'cl' THEN T.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.atom_id)FROM (
  SELECT
    T1.atom_id,
    T1.element
  FROM atom AS T1
  INNER JOIN molecule AS T2
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
  INNER JOIN bond AS T3
    ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
  WHERE
    T3.bond_type = '-'
) AS T
원래 SQL
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.element = 'cl' THEN T.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.atom_id) FROM ( SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '-' ) AS T

예측 SQL

SELECT
  (
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id)
  ) AS percentFROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond AS b
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_idWHERE
  b.bond_type = '-'GROUP BY
  b.molecule_id
원래 SQL
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id)) AS percent FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' GROUP BY b.molecule_id;

#282 오답 toxicology · challenging row_set_differs What is the ratio of Hydrogen elements in molecule ID TR006? List the ratio with its label.

질문 What is the ratio of Hydrogen elements in molecule ID TR006? List the ratio with its label.

evidence hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; ratio = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'h'), count(element)) where molecule_id = 'TR006' ; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic

정답 SQL

WITH SubQuery AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.atom_id,
    T1.element,
    T1.molecule_id,
    T2.label
  FROM atom AS T1
  INNER JOIN molecule AS T2
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
  WHERE
    T2.molecule_id = 'TR006'
)SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / (
    CASE WHEN COUNT(atom_id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(atom_id) END
  ) AS ratio,
  labelFROM SubQueryGROUP BY
  label
원래 SQL
WITH SubQuery AS (SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id, T1.element, T1.molecule_id, T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR006') SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / (CASE WHEN COUNT(atom_id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(atom_id) END) AS ratio, label FROM SubQuery GROUP BY label

예측 SQL

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN label = '+'
    THEN 'Carcinogenic'
    WHEN label = '-'
    THEN 'Non-Carcinogenic'
  END AS label,
  CAST(SUM(element = 'h') AS REAL) / COUNT(element) AS hydrogen_ratioFROM atom
JOIN molecule
  ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_idWHERE
  molecule.molecule_id = 'TR006'
원래 SQL
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' WHEN label = '-' THEN 'Non-Carcinogenic' END AS label, CAST(SUM(element = 'h') AS FLOAT) / COUNT(element) AS hydrogen_ratio FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR006';

#298 오답 toxicology · moderate single_value_differs Calculate the percentage of molecules containing carcinogenic compounds that element is hydrogen.

질문 Calculate the percentage of molecules containing carcinogenic compounds that element is hydrogen.

evidence hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+' and element = 'h'), COUNT(molecule_id)) * 100.0

정답 SQL

SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' AND T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.molecule_id)FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
원래 SQL
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' AND T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

예측 SQL

SELECT
  (
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
  ) / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentageFROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a
  ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_idWHERE
  m.label = '+'
원래 SQL
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';

evidence label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; element = 'cl' means Chlorine; element = 'c' means Carbon; element = 'h' means Hydrogen; element = 'o' means Oxygen, element = 's' means Sulfur; element = 'n' means Nitrogen, element = 'p' means Phosphorus, element = 'na' means Sodium, element = 'br' means Bromine, element = 'f' means Fluorine; element = 'i' means Iodine; element = 'sn' means Tin; element = 'pb' means Lead; element = 'te' means Tellurium; element = 'ca' means Calcium

정답 SQL

SELECT DISTINCT
  T2.molecule_id,
  T1.elementFROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_idWHERE
  T2.label = '+'
원래 SQL
SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id, T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

예측 SQL

SELECT
  m.molecule_id,
  m.label,
  a.elementFROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a
  ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_idWHERE
  m.label = '+'
원래 SQL
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';

#305 정답 toxicology · simple Name all bonds with single bond types and what atoms are connected to the molecules.

질문 Name all bonds with single bond types and what atoms are connected to the molecules.

evidence single bond refers to bond_type = '-';

정답 SQL

SELECT
  T1.bond_id,
  T2.atom_id,
  T2.atom_id2FROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2
  ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_idWHERE
  T1.bond_type = '-'
원래 SQL
SELECT T1.bond_id, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'

예측 SQL

SELECT
  b.bond_id,
  a1.atom_id AS atom1,
  a2.atom_id AS atom2FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1
  ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2
  ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_idWHERE
  b.bond_type = '-'
원래 SQL
SELECT b.bond_id, a1.atom_id AS atom1, a2.atom_id AS atom2 FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

#306 오답 toxicology · challenging row_count_differs row_set_differs Which molecules have triple bonds and list all the elements they contain.

질문 Which molecules have triple bonds and list all the elements they contain.

evidence triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; element = 'cl' means Chlorine; element = 'c' means Carbon; element = 'h' means Hydrogen; element = 'o' means Oxygen, element = 's' means Sulfur; element = 'n' means Nitrogen, element = 'p' means Phosphorus, element = 'na' means Sodium, element = 'br' means Bromine, element = 'f' means Fluorine; element = 'i' means Iodine; element = 'sn' means Tin; element = 'pb' means Lead; element = 'te' means Tellurium; element = 'ca' means Calcium

정답 SQL

SELECT DISTINCT
  T1.molecule_id,
  T2.elementFROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_idWHERE
  T1.bond_type = '#'
원래 SQL
SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id, T2.element FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'

예측 SQL

SELECT
  m.molecule_id,
  GROUP_CONCAT(a.element) AS elementsFROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#'
JOIN connected AS c
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a
  ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_idGROUP BY
  m.molecule_id
원래 SQL
SELECT m.molecule_id, GROUP_CONCAT(a.element) AS elements FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#' JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id GROUP BY m.molecule_id;

evidence chlorine refers to element = 'cl'

INNER JOIN atom AS T2
  ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_idWHERE

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id) FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl'

JOIN connected AS c

  T1.atom_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_type),
  T1.molecule_idFROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_idWHERE
  T1.molecule_id = 'TR000'GROUP BY
  T1.atom_id,
  T2.bond_type
원래 SQL

  a.atom_id,
  COUNT(b.bond_type) AS bond_countFROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m

#311 오답 toxicology · simple single_value_differs How many molecules without sulphur element is not having double bond?

질문 How many molecules without sulphur element is not having double bond?

evidence double bond refers to bond_type = ' = '; bond_type ! = ' = '; sulphur refers to element = 's'

정답 SQL

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_idWHERE
  T1.element <> 's' AND T2.bond_type <> '='
원래 SQL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element <> 's' AND T2.bond_type <> '='

예측 SQL

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS molecule_countFROM molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN bond AS b
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN connected AS c
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
LEFT JOIN atom AS a
  ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_idWHERE
  a.element IS NULL OR a.element <> 's'GROUP BY
  m.molecule_idHAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
원래 SQL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS molecule_count FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id LEFT JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id WHERE a.element IS NULL OR a.element != 's' GROUP BY m.molecule_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0;

evidence double bond refers to bond_type = '='; element = 'cl' means Chlorine; element = 'c' means Carbon; element = 'h' means Hydrogen; element = 'o' means Oxygen, element = 's' means Sulfur; element = 'n' means Nitrogen, element = 'p' means Phosphorus, element = 'na' means Sodium, element = 'br' means Bromine, element = 'f' means Fluorine; element = 'i' means Iodine; element = 'sn' means Tin; element = 'pb' means Lead; element = 'te' means Tellurium; element = 'ca' means Calcium

정답 SQL

SELECT
  T1.elementFROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_idWHERE
  T1.molecule_id = 'TR024' AND T2.bond_type = '='
원래 SQL
SELECT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR024' AND T2.bond_type = '='

예측 SQL

SELECT DISTINCT
  a.elementFROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond AS b
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_idWHERE
  b.bond_type = '=' AND a.molecule_id = 'TR024'
원래 SQL
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '=' AND a.molecule_id = 'TR024';

#329 오답 toxicology · moderate column_mismatch gold_rows_with_extra_columns Which carcinogenic molecule have the highest number of atoms consisted in it?

질문 Which carcinogenic molecule have the highest number of atoms consisted in it?

evidence label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; molecule that have the highest number of atoms consisted in in refers to MAX(COUNT(atom.molecule_id))

정답 SQL

SELECT
  T.molecule_idFROM (
  SELECT
    T2.molecule_id,
    COUNT(T1.atom_id)
  FROM atom AS T1
  INNER JOIN molecule AS T2
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
  WHERE
    T2.label = '+'
  GROUP BY
    T2.molecule_id
  ORDER BY
    COUNT(T1.atom_id) DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS t
원래 SQL
SELECT T.molecule_id FROM ( SELECT T2.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+' GROUP BY T2.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T1.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) t

예측 SQL

SELECT
  m.molecule_id,
  m.label,
  COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_countFROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a
  ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_idWHERE
  m.label = '+'GROUP BY
  m.molecule_idORDER BY
  atom_count DESCLIMIT 1
원래 SQL
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY atom_count DESC LIMIT 1;

판정 신뢰도 플래그

  • gold_rows_with_extra_columns 거짓 오답 의심: 정답 행을 그대로 포함하고 컬럼만 더 있음 (the prediction returns every gold row plus extra columns; it may be a correct answer judged wrong)

#330 오답 toxicology · challenging empty_result Calculate the percentage of carcinogenic molecules with triple bonded Hidrogen atoms.

질문 Calculate the percentage of carcinogenic molecules with triple bonded Hidrogen atoms.

evidence hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+'), COUNT(molecule_id)) * 100.0 where element = 'h' AND bond_type = '#';

정답 SQL

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)FROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
INNER JOIN bond AS T3
  ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_idWHERE
  T3.bond_type = '#' AND T2.element = 'h'
원래 SQL
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T2.element = 'h'

예측 SQL

SELECT
  (
    SUM(m.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id)
  ) AS percentageFROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#'
JOIN connected AS c
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a
  ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id AND a.element = 'h'GROUP BY
  m.molecule_id
원래 SQL
SELECT (SUM(m.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id)) AS percentage FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#' JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id AND a.element = 'h' GROUP BY m.molecule_id;

  ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN gender AS T3
  ON T1.gender_id = T3.idWHERE
  T3.gender = 'Female'
원래 SQL
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id WHERE T3.gender = 'Female'

#1339 정답 student_club · challenging Calculate the total average cost that Elijah Allen spent in the events on September and October.

질문 Calculate the total average cost that Elijah Allen spent in the events on September and October.

evidence Elijah Allen is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; The 5th and 6th string of the expense_date in the expense table can refer to month; events in September and October refers to month(expense_date) = 9 OR month(expense_date) = 10

정답 SQL

SELECT
  AVG(T2.cost)FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2
  ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_memberWHERE
  T1.last_name = 'Allen'
  AND T1.first_name = 'Elijah'
  AND (
    SUBSTRING(T2.expense_date, 6, 2) = '09'
    OR SUBSTRING(T2.expense_date, 6, 2) = '10'
  )
원래 SQL
SELECT AVG(T2.cost) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.last_name = 'Allen' AND T1.first_name = 'Elijah' AND (SUBSTR(T2.expense_date, 6, 2) = '09' OR SUBSTR(T2.expense_date, 6, 2) = '10')

예측 SQL

SELECT
  AVG(cost) AS average_costFROM expenseWHERE
  link_to_member = (
    SELECT
      member_id
    FROM member
    WHERE
      first_name = 'Elijah' AND last_name = 'Allen'
  )
  AND STRFTIME('%m', expense_date) IN ('09', '10')
원래 SQL
SELECT AVG(cost) AS average_cost FROM expense WHERE link_to_member = (SELECT member_id FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Elijah' AND last_name = 'Allen') AND strftime('%m', expense_date) IN ('09', '10');

#1340 오답 student_club · moderate single_value_differs Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Student_Club in year 2019 and 2020.

질문 Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Student_Club in year 2019 and 2020.

evidence The first 4 strings of the event_date values in the event table can represent year; The difference of the total amount spent = SUBTRACT(spent where YEAR(event_date) = 2019, spent where YEAR(event_date) = 2020)

정답 SQL

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) AS numFROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2
  ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
원래 SQL
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) AS num FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event

예측 SQL

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', e.event_date) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END) AS differenceFROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e
  ON b.link_to_event = e.event_idWHERE
  e.event_name = 'Student_Club'
원래 SQL
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'Student_Club';

#1359 오답 student_club · challenging single_value_differs How many times was the budget in Advertisement for "Yearly Kickoff" meeting more than "October Meeting"?

질문 How many times was the budget in Advertisement for "Yearly Kickoff" meeting more than "October Meeting"?

evidence budget in Advertisement refer to category = 'Advertisement' in the budget table; DIVIDE(SUM(amount when event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'), SUM(amount when event_name = 'October Meeting'))

정답 SQL

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END)FROM budget AS T1
INNER JOIN event AS T2
  ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_idWHERE
  T1.category = 'Advertisement' AND T2.type = 'Meeting'
원래 SQL
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Advertisement' AND T2.type = 'Meeting'

예측 SQL

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS times_budget_moreFROM (
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        SUM(amount)
      FROM budget
      WHERE
        link_to_event IN (
          SELECT
            event_id
          FROM event
          WHERE
            event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
        )
        AND category = 'Advertisement'
    ) AS kickoff_budget,
    (
      SELECT
        SUM(amount)
      FROM budget
      WHERE
        link_to_event IN (
          SELECT
            event_id
          FROM event
          WHERE
            event_name = 'October Meeting'
        )
        AND category = 'Advertisement'
    ) AS october_budget
) AS budgetsWHERE
  kickoff_budget > october_budget
원래 SQL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS times_budget_more FROM ( SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id FROM event WHERE event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff') AND category = 'Advertisement') AS kickoff_budget, (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id FROM event WHERE event_name = 'October Meeting') AND category = 'Advertisement') AS october_budget ) AS budgets WHERE kickoff_budget > october_budget;

#1421 오답 student_club · moderate single_value_differs Calculate the percentage of members who are major Business in the list?

질문 Calculate the percentage of members who are major Business in the list?

evidence DIVIDE(SUM(position = 'Member' and major_name = 'Business'), COUNT(member_id)) * 100

정답 SQL

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.major_name = 'Business' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.member_id)FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN major AS T2
  ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_majorWHERE
  T1.position = 'Member'
원래 SQL
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.major_name = 'Business' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.member_id) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major WHERE T1.position = 'Member'

예측 SQL

SELECT
  (
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN m.position = 'Member' AND maj.major_name = 'Business' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) * 100.0
  ) / COUNT(m.member_id) AS percentage_business_membersFROM member AS m
LEFT JOIN major AS maj
  ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
원래 SQL
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN m.position = 'Member' AND maj.major_name = 'Business' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(m.member_id) AS percentage_business_members FROM member m LEFT JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id;

#1437 오답 student_club · challenging column_mismatch gold_rows_with_extra_columns Which members who were approved from 1/10/2019 to 11/19/2019? Please identify the member who attended the event and the link to their event.

질문 Which members who were approved from 1/10/2019 to 11/19/2019? Please identify the member who attended the event and the link to their event.

evidence approved from 1/10/2019 to 11/19/2019 refers to approved = 'true' and expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' and '2019-11-19'

정답 SQL

SELECT DISTINCT
  T1.link_to_member,
  T3.link_to_eventFROM expense AS T1
INNER JOIN member AS T2
  ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id
INNER JOIN attendance AS T3
  ON T2.member_id = T3.link_to_memberWHERE
  DATE(SUBSTRING(T1.expense_date, 1, 10)) BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND T1.approved = 'true'
원래 SQL
SELECT DISTINCT T1.link_to_member, T3.link_to_event FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN attendance AS T3 ON T2.member_id = T3.link_to_member WHERE date(SUBSTR(T1.expense_date, 1, 10)) BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19' AND T1.approved = 'true'

예측 SQL

SELECT
  m.member_id,
  m.first_name,
  m.last_name,
  a.link_to_eventFROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e
  ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN attendance AS a
  ON a.link_to_member = m.member_idWHERE
  e.approved = 'true' AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19'
원래 SQL
SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, a.link_to_event FROM member m JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE e.approved = 'true' AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

#1448 오답 student_club · challenging empty_result Find the name and date of events with expenses for pizza that were more than fifty dollars but less than a hundred dollars.

질문 Find the name and date of events with expenses for pizza that were more than fifty dollars but less than a hundred dollars.

evidence name of event refers to event_name; date of event refers to event_date; expenses for pizza refers to expense_description = 'Pizza' where cost > 50 and cost < 100

정답 SQL

SELECT
  T1.event_name,
  T1.event_dateFROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2
  ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
INNER JOIN expense AS T3
  ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budgetWHERE
  T3.expense_description = 'Pizza' AND T3.cost > 50 AND T3.cost < 100
원래 SQL
SELECT T1.event_name, T1.event_date FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T3.expense_description = 'Pizza' AND T3.cost > 50 AND T3.cost < 100

예측 SQL

SELECT
  e.event_name,
  e.event_dateFROM event AS e
JOIN expense AS ex
  ON e.event_id = ex.link_to_budgetWHERE
  ex.expense_description = 'Pizza' AND ex.cost > 50 AND ex.cost < 100
원래 SQL
SELECT e.event_name, e.event_date FROM event e JOIN expense ex ON e.event_id = ex.link_to_budget WHERE ex.expense_description = 'Pizza' AND ex.cost > 50 AND ex.cost < 100;

#1450 오답 student_club · simple empty_result In the events with more than forty incomes, list the city and country in which the event is happening.

질문 In the events with more than forty incomes, list the city and country in which the event is happening.

evidence more than fifty incomes refers to income > 40

정답 SQL

SELECT DISTINCT
  T3.city,
  T3.countyFROM income AS T1
INNER JOIN member AS T2
  ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id
INNER JOIN zip_code AS T3
  ON T3.zip_code = T2.zipWHERE
  T1.amount > 40
원래 SQL
SELECT DISTINCT T3.city, T3.county FROM income AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN zip_code AS T3 ON T3.zip_code = T2.zip WHERE T1.amount > 40

예측 SQL

SELECT
  z.city,
  z.countyFROM income AS i
JOIN member AS m
  ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN attendance AS a
  ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN event AS e
  ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN zip_code AS z
  ON m.zip = z.zip_codeGROUP BY
  e.event_idHAVING
  COUNT(i.income_id) > 40
원래 SQL
SELECT z.city, z.county FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code GROUP BY e.event_id HAVING COUNT(i.income_id) > 40;

#1451 오답 student_club · challenging empty_result column_mismatch Among the members who incurred expenses in more than one event, who paid the most amount?

질문 Among the members who incurred expenses in more than one event, who paid the most amount?

evidence paid the most amount refers to for expense incurred in more than one event refers to MAX(cost where COUNT(event_id) > 1)

정답 SQL

SELECT
  T2.member_idFROM expense AS T1
INNER JOIN member AS T2
  ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id
INNER JOIN budget AS T3
  ON T1.link_to_budget = T3.budget_id
INNER JOIN event AS T4
  ON T3.link_to_event = T4.event_idGROUP BY
  T2.member_idHAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT T4.event_id) > 1ORDER BY
  SUM(T1.cost) DESCLIMIT 1
원래 SQL
SELECT T2.member_id FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T1.link_to_budget = T3.budget_id INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T3.link_to_event = T4.event_id GROUP BY T2.member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T4.event_id) > 1 ORDER BY SUM(T1.cost) DESC LIMIT 1

예측 SQL

SELECT
  link_to_member,
  SUM(cost) AS total_expenseFROM expenseWHERE
  link_to_budget IN (
    SELECT
      link_to_budget
    FROM expense
    GROUP BY
      link_to_member,
      link_to_budget
    HAVING
      COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_budget) > 1
  )GROUP BY
  link_to_memberORDER BY
  total_expense DESCLIMIT 1
원래 SQL
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IN ( SELECT link_to_budget FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_budget HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_budget) > 1 ) GROUP BY link_to_member ORDER BY total_expense DESC LIMIT 1;

#1454 오답 student_club · moderate single_value_differs What is the percentage of the cost for the meeting events?

질문 What is the percentage of the cost for the meeting events?

evidence meeting events refers to type = 'Meeting'; percentage = DIVIDE( SUM(cost), COUNT(event_id)) * 100

정답 SQL

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.type = 'Meeting' THEN T3.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100 / SUM(T3.cost)FROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2
  ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
INNER JOIN expense AS T3
  ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget
원래 SQL
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.type = 'Meeting' THEN T3.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100 / SUM(T3.cost) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget

예측 SQL

SELECT
  (
    SUM(cost) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id)
  ) AS percentageFROM expense AS ex
JOIN budget AS b
  ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS e
  ON b.link_to_event = e.event_idWHERE
  e.type = 'Meeting'
원래 SQL
SELECT (SUM(cost) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id)) AS percentage FROM expense ex JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Meeting';

#1458 오답 student_club · moderate single_value_differs Calculate the difference in the percentage of members in New Jersey and Vermont.

evidence SUBTRACT( DIVIDE( SUM(state = 'New Jersey'), COUNT(position = 'Member')), DIVIDE( SUM(state = 'Vermont'), COUNT(position = 'Member')) )

정답 SQL

SELECT
  CAST((
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.state = 'New Jersey' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.state = 'Vermont' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.member_id) AS diffFROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2
  ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip

SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T2.state = 'New Jersey' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.state = 'Vermont' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.member_id) AS diff FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip

예측 SQL

  (
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.state = 'New Jersey' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN m.position = 'Member' THEN 1 END)
  ) - (
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.state = 'Vermont' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN m.position = 'Member' THEN 1 END)
  ) AS percentage_differenceFROM member AS m
JOIN zip_code AS z
  ON m.zip = z.zip_code
원래 SQL
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN z.state = 'New Jersey' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN m.position = 'Member' THEN 1 END)) - (SUM(CASE WHEN z.state = 'Vermont' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN m.position = 'Member' THEN 1 END)) AS percentage_difference FROM member m JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code;
